product_overview: Digi Ai is a digital services platform enabling retailers and end-users to perform PAN services, recharges, bill payments, government service applications, and e-commerce transactions with integrated wallet and admin management.
core_goals: Enable retailers and end-users to access a broad set of digital and government services from a single portal.
Provide a secure wallet and payments system (Cashfree, Razorpay) for fast transactions and reconciliations.
Support multi-role access (Admin, Employee, Retailer) with dashboards, analytics, and operational tools.
Integrate external providers (KwikAPI, InsPay) for recharges, bill payments, and PAN services with status tracking.
Offer reliable service workflows with traceability (applications, transactions, notifications) and support channels.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: User registration, login, password reset and session management for customers, retailers and admins.
user_flows: POST /api/auth/register with new user details -> Receive 200 user created -> POST /api/auth/login with registered credentials -> Receive 200 with token and user

POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials -> Receive 401 Invalid credentials -> POST /api/auth/forgot-password with registered email -> Receive 200 email sent -> POST /api/auth/reset-password with reset token and new password -> Receive 200 password updated

features.name: Dashboard
features.description: User dashboard providing personalised stats, wallet balance and quick navigation to services.
user_flows: GET /api/dashboard/stats with valid JWT -> Receive 200 stats object
GET /api/dashboard/stats without JWT or invalid token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Wallet Management
features.description: View wallet balance, add money, withdraw and review transaction history.
user_flows: GET /api/wallet/balance with valid JWT -> Receive 200 balance -> POST /api/wallet/add-money with {amount} and JWT -> Receive 200 transaction created -> GET /api/wallet/transactions with JWT -> Receive 200 transactions array
POST /api/wallet/withdraw with {amount} and JWT where amount > balance -> Receive 400 Insufficient balance

features.name: Mobile Recharge
features.description: Prepaid and postpaid mobile recharges with operator detection and plan browsing.
user_flows: POST /api/recharge/detect-operator with {mobile} -> Receive 200 operator info -> GET /api/recharge/plans?operator=<operator>&circle=<circle> -> Receive 200 plans array -> POST /api/recharge/process with {mobile,operator,amount,circle} and JWT -> Receive 200 recharge initiated
POST /api/recharge/process with missing required fields or invalid amount -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Bill Payments
features.description: Fetch bill details and pay utility bills (electricity, gas, water, DTH, cableTV, FASTag) via KwikAPI.
user_flows: GET /api/kwikapi/billers?category=electricity -> Receive 200 billers array -> POST /api/kwikapi/bill-fetch with {billerId,params} and JWT -> Receive 200 bill details -> POST /api/kwikapi/bill-payment with {billerId,amount,params} and JWT -> Receive 200 payment initiated
POST /api/kwikapi/bill-payment with missing params -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: PAN Card Services
features.description: Submit new PAN applications and corrections through InsPay, track history and status.
user_flows: POST /api/pan-services/new-pan with application payload and JWT -> Receive 200 application submitted -> GET /api/pan-services/check-status?applicationId=<id> with JWT -> Receive 200 status info
POST /api/pan-services/new-pan with missing documents or invalid payload -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Government Services Applications
features.description: Browse government services, submit applications with document uploads and view application details.
user_flows: GET /api/services -> Receive 200 services array -> POST /api/applications with {serviceId,documents,metadata} and JWT -> Receive 200 application created -> GET /api/applications/<id> with JWT -> Receive 200 application object
POST /api/applications with incomplete document set -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Admin Panel
features.description: Admin dashboard for managing users, applications, platform analytics and wallet withdrawal requests.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/users with admin JWT -> Receive 200 users array -> GET /api/admin/analytics with admin JWT -> Receive 200 analytics data
GET /api/admin/users with non-admin or insufficiently privileged JWT -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Employee Management
features.description: Create and manage employees, view hierarchy and referral assignments.
user_flows: POST /api/employees/create with {employeeData} and admin/HR JWT -> Receive 200 employee created -> GET /api/employees/list with JWT -> Receive 200 employees array -> GET /api/employees/hierarchy with JWT -> Receive 200 hierarchy object
POST /api/employees/create with insufficient permissions -> Receive 403 Forbidden

features.name: Products & E-commerce
features.description: Browse product catalog, view details and place orders via the platform.
user_flows: GET /api/products -> Receive 200 products array -> GET /api/products/<id> -> Receive 200 product object -> POST /api/orders with {cart,shipping,payment} and JWT -> Receive 200 order created
POST /api/orders with expired or missing JWT -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Notifications
features.description: In-app notifications list with the ability to mark items read/unread.
user_flows: GET /api/notifications with JWT -> Receive 200 notifications array -> PATCH /api/notifications/<id> with {read:true} and JWT -> Receive 200 updated
PATCH /api/notifications/<invalid-id> with JWT -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Blog
features.description: Public blog posts with commenting functionality for authenticated users.
user_flows: GET /api/blog/posts -> Receive 200 posts array -> POST /api/blog/comments with {postId,comment} and JWT -> Receive 200 comment created
POST /api/blog/comments without JWT -> Receive 401 Unauthorized

features.name: Subscription Plans
features.description: List available subscription plans and enable users to purchase and view their active subscription.
user_flows: GET /api/subscriptions/plans -> Receive 200 plans array -> POST /api/subscriptions/purchase with {planId} and JWT -> Receive 200 subscription created -> GET /api/subscriptions/my-subscription with JWT -> Receive 200 subscription object
POST /api/subscriptions/purchase with invalid planId -> Receive 400 Validation error

features.name: Referral System
features.description: Generate and submit referral codes to apply rewards and track referrals.
user_flows: POST /api/referrals/generate-code with JWT -> Receive 200 referral code -> POST /api/referrals/submit with {code} and JWT -> Receive 200 referral applied
POST /api/referrals/submit with invalid or expired code and JWT -> Receive 400 Invalid referral code

features.name: Public Pages & Contact
features.description: Public-facing landing, about, contact and legal pages with a contact form for inquiries.
user_flows: POST /api/public/contact with {name,email,message} -> Receive 200 message sent
POST /api/public/contact with invalid email format -> Receive 400 Validation error
